rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people or objects physically hitting each other.

example.english: When the two cars collide at the intersection, luckily no one is hurt.
example.traditional: 兩架車喺十字路口撞埋一齊，好彩冇人受傷。
example.jyutping: loeng5 gaa3 ce1 hai2 sap6 zi6 lou6 hau2 zong6 maai4 jat1 cai4 hou2 coi2 mou5 jan4 sau6 soeng1

rows.note: Use this when people, countries, ideas, or systems come into conflict or are incompatible.

example.english: These two policies collide with each other, so they cannot be implemented together.
example.traditional: 呢兩個政策互相衝突，根本冇可能一齊推行。
example.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 go3 zing3 caak3 wu6 soeng1 cung1 dat6 gan1 bun2 mou5 ho2 nang4 jat1 cai4 teoi1 hang4

rows.traditional: 令 A 同 B 撞埋一齊
rows.jyutping: ling6 A tung4 B zong6 maai4 jat1 cai4
rows.note: Use this causative construction when someone or something makes two things collide.

example.english: The roadblock causes the two cars and a truck to collide.
example.traditional: 個路障令兩架車同一架貨車撞埋一齊。
example.jyutping: go3 lou6 zoeng3 ling6 loeng5 gaa3 ce1 tung4 jat1 gaa3 fo3 ce1 zong6 maai4 jat1 cai4
